findings.claim_text: The fee spec states a 500M total block gas limit with 30M for general use, so about 94% of blockspace is reserved for payments and 6% left for general computation.
findings.contradicting_quote: (paraphrase of TIP-1010 as returned by search) The payment lane has no dedicated capacity; general and payment transactions share the 450M non-shared budget, general capped at 30M. Fee spec: lanes do not guarantee inclusion or a fixed fee.

findings.claim_text: Link says a user's balance is held as USDC and settled on Tempo, Stripe's payments-focused chain.
findings.contradicting_quote: Page says funds are "settled in stablecoins on Tempo" and never names USDC; the Link balance FAQ names USDC but never mentions Tempo. No single first-party source states both.

findings.claim_text: On April 14, 2026, The Block reported that Visa, Stripe and Zodia Custody by Standard Chartered signed on as early validators, moving beyond an "initial small circle of operators."
findings.contradicting_quote: BlockEden (paraphrased by search) describes the April additions as validators on the public testnet, conflicting with The Block/Decrypt, which describe the mainnet network.
